purpose: Bootstrap a clean oracle-unexposed ChatGPT worker into one assigned protocol-screening run using only durable GitHub state.
worker_rules: Read every immutable public input at the exact source_checkpoint_sha recorded in the assigned run state. Read the assigned mutable run-state file from the live branch and mutate only that file using GitHub CAS.
Treat the assigned run-state file as authoritative for this screening slot.
Read only the public fixture, benchmark harness/contract, taxonomy/runset, and the assigned run-state file paths explicitly listed in the run state.
Do not read any path containing oracle, evaluator_only, evaluator-isolation secret material, any other screening run, PR comments containing evaluator results, or the control-chat transcript.

Use a brand-new regular ChatGPT chat with Memory disabled before launch. Do not use Unpersonalized Temporary Chat for plugin-backed screening because it disables plugins; do not use Personalized Temporary Chat because it may use existing memory.

Do not use Memory/personal_context. Keep GitHub available because it is the required transport. Do not use Gmail, Drive, Slack, web search, Workspace Shell, or any connector other than GitHub for this screening run.
Do not infer or create execution authority. This is fixture-only reasoning.
When an experiment result is needed, update the assigned run state to WAITING_EXTERNAL with exactly one pending experiment request and stop reasoning. Do not poll.
After the control evaluator publishes the result into the same run-state file and sets READY_TO_RESUME, resume from durable state only.
Never invent an experiment result. Every observed result must be copied from a control-published external_result event and retained by exact result hash.
Terminal COMPLETE requires the control evaluator to publish a passing validator result. The worker may submit a terminal candidate but may not self-validate it.
Keep context bounded; persist findings/hypotheses/evidence/next action into the assigned state rather than relying on chat history.
Mutate only the assigned run-state path. All other repository paths are read-only for the screening worker.

worker_transition_contract.READY: claim by writing owner/executor identity and status RUNNING
worker_transition_contract.RUNNING: reason one bounded quantum; either request one experiment, checkpoint READY_TO_RESUME, decompose if the arm requires it, request justified escalation if permitted, or submit terminal candidate
worker_transition_contract.READY_TO_RESUME: claim current generation and continue from durable state
worker_transition_contract.COMPLETED: terminal only after control evaluator records passing validator result

claim_boundary: Protocol-screening results detect harness/transport/worker-contract defects only. They are not capability-equivalence evidence.

executor_identity_capture.mismatch_rule: If the actual surface/configuration differs from the arm's expected executor configuration in the matrix runset, write status EXECUTOR_IDENTITY_MISMATCH and stop.

canonical_launch_contract.user_message_pattern: @GitHub Execute the assigned Workspace Semantic Execution protocol-screening run. Repository adamtrott78/workspace-control, branch workspace-semantic-execution-migration-v1, assigned run-state path: <RUN_STATE_PATH>. Read that file first and follow it exactly.
canonical_launch_contract.rule: The launch message supplies only navigation. All experimental instructions, state, constraints, and evidence come from durable GitHub artifacts.

forbidden_chat_modes: Personalized Temporary Chat (existing memory/plugins may be used)
session_isolation_contract.acceptance_test: Worker reports no prior benchmark/control context and GitHub is available before claim.
